name: B-l43-edit-s414-v2
prompt: <image1> shows a creature at its adult stage. Draw the same creature grown into its elder stage. Body change: the whole silhouette changes into a majestic, very long lagoon dragon without teeth flying sideways: the body stretches horizontally across the whole image in one big wave-like S-curve, the head becomes smaller in relation to the long body, the fin-wings become two pairs of wide flowing turquoise fins, the turquoise crest becomes long trailing ribbons, and the gill fronds have grown into a soft crown. Keep from <image1>: the face with its eyes, small mouth and coral cheeks, three feathery coral gill fronds on each side of the head like an axolotl, and one continuous cream belly stripe running from the chin to the tip of the tail, the apricot and cream colors and the flat two-tone style without outlines. One creature, full body, three-quarter front view, plain flat pale mint background.
